Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.Style_tooltip:
Dots: a coloured dot per status. Icons: crossed swords, warning, shield, star, house.
Default Icons (2).
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.HeadHeight_toolt:
How far above the NPC's feet the marker sits. Raise if it covers the hair, lower if it floats.
Default 1.15.
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapEnabled_toolt:
Allow stance icons on the world map and minimap. Each player can still turn them off in Options > Mods.
Default on.
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapMaxRange_tool:
Most tiles from a player an NPC can be and still show on their map. Players pick their own range up to this.
Default 300.
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapForceLineOfSi: Map: only NPCs players have seen

Players only see NPCs on the map they can see or saw recently (their own 'Remember seen NPCs' time), whatever they pick.
Default off.
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapResidentsAnyw:
Allow players to see their base's residents on the map at any distance. Off: residents follow the range like everyone else.
Default on.
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapShowResident: Map (multiplayer): show Your base's residents (blue house)
Sandbox_ALifeStanceDots.MapShow_tooltip:
Multiplayer only: the server decides which statuses show on everyone's map, and players' own ticks are ignored. In singleplayer each player picks in Options > Mods.
Default on.
